title: ロボット応用力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Dynamics of Machine Systems I
keywords: Damping force 2.Restoring force 3.Potential energy 4.Mechanical energy conservation law 5.Lagrange equation
educationalGoal: In this course, students learn how to derive the equations of motion for the complex behavior of rigid bodies and a mass point system by applying the Lagrange equation, in addition to analyzing the motion of a mass subject to external forces such as restoring forces and damping forces, and using the law of conservation of mechanical energy.
advice: Dynamics is the basis of robot kinematics, and students are required to set up and solve the equations of motion. In this course, the following mechanics topics are covered: 1. Equation of motion of a mass point subject to damping force 2. Equation of motion of a mass point subject to restoring force 3. Conservative forces and potential energy 4. Mechanical energy conservation law 5. Application of the Lagrange equation
requiredKnowledge: ・Mathematical knowledge of differential/integral calculus, differential equations, vectors, etc. ・Engineering Mechanics I&II

activityGoals.body: Understand the motion of a mass point subject to damping forces.
Understand the motion of a mass point subject to damping forces.
Understand and apply the law of conservation of mechanical energy.
Derive the equations of motion of a mass system from the Lagrange equation.
Derive the equations of motion of a rigid body from the Lagrange equation.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1.Solve the equations of motion of a mass point subject to damping force. 2.Solve the equations of motion of a mass point subject to restoring force. 3.Explain dynamic behavior using the law of conservation of mechanical energy. 4.Set up Lagrange equations using generalized coordinates. 5.Describe a complex system of masses and rigid bodies using the Lagrange equation.
achievementLevels.standard: 1.Explain the motion of a mass point subject to damping force. 2.Explain the motion of a mass point subject to restoring force. 3.Understand and use the law of conservation of mechanical energy. 4.Understand and use Lagrange equations. 5.Describe the equation of motion of a mass system and rigid body using the Lagrange equation.

lessons.content: Course introduction Law of motion Solving differential equations by Separation of Variables Method
Motion of point mass Viscous damping force and viscous resistance force
Restoring force and vibration Harmonic motion and circular motion・
Potential energy Concervative force and field of force
Mechanical energy conservation law Momentum conservation law
Review of Intermediate test Freedom of motion and constraints Non-conservative force and dissipation function
Covariance of Lagrange equation Coordinate transformation
Derivation of the equations of motion for a mass system by the Lagrange equation
Moment of inertia and Kinematic energy of rotating system Derivation of equations of motion for rigid bodies by Lagrange equation
Rigid body motion with fixed axis Application of the Lagrange equation to a solid pendulum
Rigid body motion in plane motion Application of the Lagrange equation to composite system of masses and rigid bodies

lessons.assignments: Check your comprehension of the entire course
